ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1 macro-level ratio of high-intensity (mottled white) to low-intensity (dark pigmented) regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity contiguous region extending from the base to the median notch. Two large high-intensity blobs with fine low-intensity mottling occupy the interior of the left and right lobes. Low-intensity pigmentation follows the entire trailing edge boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 60 degrees and a vertical depth comprising ~12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular peaks (serrations) on the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a higher frequency of smaller, lower-amplitude serrations. Tip regions show distinct jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a complex non-linear curve, transitioning from concave near the median notch to convex toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several distinct circular ring-like scars visible: one on the inner upper right lobe, one in the lower center-left mottled area, and one in the mid-right lobe. Dense clusters of high-contrast barnacles on both the far-left and far-right tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned high-contrast linear marks (scratches) detected across the central dark pigmentation and lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on lateral tips; multiple circular depigmented scars indicative of parasite attachment or physical trauma present on both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, deeply notched profile of the left lobe's trailing edge compared to the relatively smoother serration of the right lobe.
